classes.name: Hepatitis C direct-acting antivirals
classes.description: Sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (Epclusa and authorized generic), glecaprevir/pibrentasvir (Mavyret), ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (Harvoni and authorized generic), sofosbuvir/velpatasvir/voxilaprevir (Vosevi), elbasvir/grazoprevir (Zepatier).
classes.plainDescription: An 8 to 12 week course of pills that cures hepatitis C.

preferredAgent.strength: Tablet (400 mg / 100 mg per standard label; strength not printed on PDL)
preferredAgent.sig: No cirrhosis or compensated cirrhosis: 1 tablet once daily for 12 weeks. Decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B or C): 1 tablet once daily plus weight-based ribavirin for 12 weeks (label).
preferredAgent.sigShort: 1 tab QD x12 wk (+ribavirin if decompensated)
preferredAgent.plainSig: One pill a day for 12 weeks; people with advanced liver scarring also take ribavirin.

records.preferredRestriction: Clinical criteria apply to all HCV agents (genotype, cirrhosis, prior-treatment criteria) (PDL p.4). PA not required for this product (PDL p.4).

records.verificationNote: Read p.4 Antivirals (Hepatitis C Agents). Preferred: Mavyret tablet and pellet pack, and generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir (generic Epclusa), with 'Prior Approval Not Required' printed for Mavyret and sofosbuvir-velpatasvir only. Generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir chosen as the lowest-barrier preferred pick. Strength and 12-week duration are label standard, not printed. Pegasys and ribavirin on p.4 are not DAAs and were not recorded. Brand Epclusa is not preferred, so BOGL is not active.

records.verificationNote: Read PDF p.12-13. Every hepatitis C DAA listed carries PA and specialty flags, so the pick is judgment: sofosbuvir-velpatasvir generic 400/100 mg is the lowest-barrier product on flags (PA and Specialty, no RA/ST), and the Epclusa-equivalent generic is the common product. Zepatier (elbasvir-grazoprevir) is not in this document. The Epclusa tablet brand is not listed; only its pellet packs are. [Sonnet check 2026-11-02: generic sofosbuvir-velpatasvir confirmed Tier 2 with Specialty + PA and no RA (PDF p.13).]
